traits.bark_colour.note: The bark colour chosen by eye for appearance (see its note), as a screen colour: it stood as appearance.bark [0.4, 0.3, 0.25], which is linear light, so the trunk drew pale grey to white beside photographs of the species (2026-10-23). It stands here in sRGB, as bark colours are picked, and the bark rule (tracheophyta) turns it into linear light.

traits.flowering_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2426789), as no source read gives it.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2426789), as no source read gives it.

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 8 (2009), Ribes divaricatum (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): "Plants 1-3 m."

generator.params.note: Red-flowering currant's values, changed for spreading gooseberry: wider branch and fork angles and a little more droop for its erect to spreading, straggly stems (FNA vol. 8); a thorn beside each bud, 12 mm, the middle of FNA's nodal spines of 5-20 mm (the program draws two at every node, where FNA has none or 1-3); crown_radius, path_half, leaf_size, spur_leaf and bloom_size left to the rules from the traits. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 1.8 m at 12 years in the open, within FNA's 1-3 m. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: After FNA vol. 8: a roundish palmate leaf of 3 lobes cleft half way to the midrib ("3- (or 5-)lobed, cleft 1/2 to midrib"), the petiole's share of the card from the petiole of 1-3 cm against the blade of 2-3.5 cm; ripe berries "purplish black", glabrous, so no waxy bloom; leaves and bark as red-flowering currant's, by eye, as FNA gives no colour for them.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

appearance.organs.bloom.season.flower_lo.note: Its flowers drawn one by one, as red-flowering currant's: spreading-reflexed sepals "red or reddish or purplish green" (the look's colour) around small erect petals, white in var. divaricatum (the accent), on an obconic hypanthium (FNA vol. 8, read on eFloras 2026-10-18). Its size is left to the rule from the flower, sepal, petal and fruit sizes.

Read as prickles: the nodal spines of gooseberries grow from the bark below the leaf, not from a bud, so the vocabulary's thorns (from shoots) does not fit.
